lines.en: I make a round along my stall.

lines.zh: 我手里那叠票被风吹动。
lines.en: The wind stirs the tickets in my hand.
I walk to the corner and return.

lines.zh: 我脚步很轻，怕惊着买家。
lines.en: My steps are light lest buyers startle.

lines.zh: 我从这个村走到那个村。
lines.en: I go from this village to that one.

lines.zh: 我背着箱子，箱子是空的。
lines.en: I carry a case; the case is empty.
When others step aside, I nod.

lines.zh: 我绕开那群吵闹的村民。
lines.en: I steer around the noisy villagers.
I take the same road every day.
The soles of my shoes are worn flat.
I reach the stall and spread the cloth.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，好看清每个人。
lines.en: I walk slow to see each face.

lines.zh: 有人喊我，我装着没听见。
lines.en: Someone calls; I pretend not to hear.
I am heading toward the market.

lines.zh: 我数着箱子里剩几张票。
lines.en: I count the tickets left in the case.
I lean on the post and say nothing.
Nobody comes, so I watch the sky.
I sort the tickets by color.
I neither shout nor wave.
I remember everyone who did not come.
I blow the dust off the cloth three times.
I wait for someone who will not ask.
Numbers turn over in my head.
I am not sleepy, only unwilling to move.

lines.zh: 阳光照在票上，金字发亮。
lines.en: Sun on the tickets lights the gold print.
I tuck my hands into my sleeves.
This spot is poor today.
I hear the bell and do not move.
You look at me; I look past you.
Do not touch that ticket.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，也不想认识。
lines.en: I do not know you, nor wish to.
Your face says what you want.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你一下，又低头。
lines.en: I glance up, then look down.
You talk; I only nod.
Your purse is jingling.
I am not selling anything.
You linger; I shift my stance.
You wait for me to speak first.

lines.zh: 帽檐挡住我的眼，正合适。
lines.en: My brim hides my eyes; that suits me.

lines.zh: 你身后有个小孩在看票。
lines.en: A child behind you is eyeing the tickets.
You do not look like a buyer.

lines.zh: 我什么都没说，你也没走。
lines.en: I said nothing, and you stayed.

lines.zh: 你的钱还没掏出来，我已经算好了。
lines.en: You haven't paid yet. I already did the math.

lines.zh: 你别站在摊子中间，挡着别人了。
lines.en: Don't stand in the middle of my stall. You're blocking others.
That cost me a heart.
I am bleeding; do not soil the tickets.
I back up behind the stall.
It hurts, but I do not strike back.
You strike a man who will not hit back.
My hat came off.
I clutch my ribs and bend.
Days will pass before this closes.
I looked at you once, silent.
You have made a mess of this place.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我不感兴趣。
lines.en: I have no interest in what you hold.
I lack coin? No, something else.
You raise a ticket; I turn away.
I smell copper and still do not move.
You name a price; I do not take it.
I have already done those sums.
Do not wave it; waving changes nothing.
You cannot hand me what I want.
The harder you press, the slower I answer.

lines.zh: 我只看了那枚硬币一眼。
lines.en: I gave that coin one look.
You bump me and tickets scatter.
I crouch to gather them; you help; I flinch.
I step back and hug the case.

lines.zh: 你靠得太近了，往旁边些。
lines.en: Too close; move aside.
I never push, only yield.
You caught my sleeve.
We pass; I do not look up.
That ticket is muddied now.
I guard the stall and let you pass.
A light bump; I will not hit back.
I had a partner, long unseen.
We each keep our own stall.

lines.zh: 他也卖票，我们从不抢客。
lines.en: He sells tickets too; we never compete.
We meet twice a year.
I cannot recall his full name.
We counted the tickets between us.
When he left, the stall went empty.

lines.zh: 我们不谈生意，只谈天气。
lines.en: We speak of weather, never business.
I kept one ticket for him.
People like us are not common.
I pick up a crumpled ticket.
I drop the coins into an inner pocket.
I studied that one on the ground.
I pick up a snapped cord.
This coin is false; I toss it.
I set it exactly where it stood.
What falls is not always mine.
I pick it up, rub it, and stow it.

lines.zh: 客人掉的，我留着等人来。
lines.en: A customer dropped it; I keep it for them.
My hands are steady.

lines.zh: 你在我摊前站得太久了。
lines.en: You have stood at my stall too long.
You are sizing up my case.

lines.zh: 你手里握着东西，没亮出来。
lines.en: You hold something, hidden.
You have walked behind the stall.
Things have not been quiet here.
You asked what should not be asked.
Your eyes never leave the tickets.
I have your face now.
I will watch when you leave.
Ten hearts is not so easy a mark.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，手能伸到箱子。
lines.en: I turn so my hand can reach the case.
You step in; I step back.

lines.zh: 你的手指动一下，我都记下。
lines.en: Every twitch of your fingers, noted.

lines.zh: 我把票叠成一整齐的叠。
lines.en: I square the tickets into a stack.
You are waiting for me to turn.

lines.zh: 先伸手的人从来不是我。
lines.en: I am never the one who reaches first.
I roll the cloth up slowly.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的箱子上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my case.
I count how much patience you have left.

lines.zh: 你等着，我也等着，看谁先。
lines.en: You wait, I wait; let us see who first.
I do not fight; you forced this.

lines.zh: 箱子横过来，替我挨了一下。
lines.en: The case swings across and takes the blow.
A light punch; out of practice.
I hit and run; not very fast.
Tickets spilled out of the case.
I was guarding the stock, not you.
I do not shout; no one would come.

lines.zh: 这一下是给你长记性的。
lines.en: That was to teach you something.
Ten hearts does not last long.
We are even now; go.

lines.zh: 我把摊子支在这条街口。
lines.en: I set my stall at this street corner.
Where tickets are wanted, someone like me appears.
I came when this village was new.
I brought the case myself.
I spread the cloth and wait.
The people here do not know me yet.
My first deal fell through.
I picked this corner and stayed.
It is early; I lay out the tickets.
I never lack a place to stand.
Fire! I grab the tickets first.
I fall on the stall and tear the cloth.
I cannot swim; the case sinks first.
After the blast I look for tickets.

lines.zh: 箭钉在箱盖上，吓我一跳。
lines.en: The arrow pins the lid; I startle.
That potion takes my voice.

lines.zh: 我饿着，也不肯花钱买饭。
lines.en: I starve rather than spend on food.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我抱着箱子蹲下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; I crouch over the case.
Falling, I still grip the tickets.
